definitions.execution_time_reduction_percent: 100 * (1 - candidate_time / baseline_time); negative means longer execution
definitions.aggregate_speed: Equal-workload geometric mean of median speedup ratios; not total elapsed time
definitions.pass_population_variance: Population variance of case outcomes (pass=1, fail=0), p*(1-p); not a correctness guarantee
definitions.numeric_error: Candidate minus baseline scalar return value; exceptions and non-finite/non-numeric outputs excluded
definitions.timing_variance: Population variance of per-call batch timing samples; UI units are microseconds squared
definitions.p05_p95: Interpolated empirical timing percentiles, not confidence bounds
definitions.missing_values: null means not measured or not applicable; do not plot missing values as zero
definitions.correctness_groups: Candidate-specific suites differ; use the shared source group for like-for-like comparisons
definitions.duplicate_code: identical_to marks byte-identical code; measured speed differences between those files are noise
definitions.coverage: Case counts include repeated inputs across coverage sources; passing finite tests does not prove equivalence
